gromacs-molecular-dynamics.summary: GROMACS simulates the motion of interacting particles.
gromacs-molecular-dynamics.workload: The supplied water and argon systems evolve under prescribed interaction models, integration steps and output schedules.
gromacs-molecular-dynamics.correctness: The trajectories, energies and final particle state must agree with the reference, and replaying a simulation must reproduce its trajectories and energies.
gromacs-molecular-dynamics.timing: Timing covers the complete mdrun simulation. Compilation and input preparation take place before the clock starts.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/gromacs-molecular-dynamics — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

lammps-molecular-dynamics.summary: LAMMPS follows the motion of atoms in a molecular dynamics simulation.
lammps-molecular-dynamics.workload: The serial solver runs generated molecular dynamics inputs and writes a checkpoint for continuation.
lammps-molecular-dynamics.correctness: The verifier compares thermodynamic histories, trajectory frames and the final atomic state. An unmodified LAMMPS binary must resume the checkpoint and reproduce the reference continuation.
lammps-molecular-dynamics.timing: Timing includes the simulation process and the continuation that the unmodified binary runs from its checkpoint.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/lammps-molecular-dynamics — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

gpaw-fd-dft-restart.summary: GPAW computes electronic structure with finite-difference density functional theory.
gpaw-fd-dft-restart.workload: Each molecular or periodic crystal case runs a self-consistent calculation, takes prescribed geometry steps and resumes from a saved state.
gpaw-fd-dft-restart.correctness: Snapshot fields, atomic identities and integrated electron density are checked. The unmodified application must also resume the checkpoint and reproduce the continued calculation.
gpaw-fd-dft-restart.timing: The timer covers the initial workflow and the resume process. Separate checkpoint checks are outside the timed interval.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/gpaw-fd-dft-restart — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

qe-scf-nscf-dos.summary: Quantum ESPRESSO calculates electronic states and the density of states of a crystal.
qe-scf-nscf-dos.workload: The workflow runs self-consistent and non-self-consistent calculations with supplied pseudopotentials, extracts the charge density and computes the density of states.
qe-scf-nscf-dos.correctness: The verifier checks physical arrays, aligned wavefunctions, charge density, density of states, convergence and checkpoint recovery.
qe-scf-nscf-dos.timing: Timing covers the initial electronic calculation, density postprocessing, the non-self-consistent calculation and the density-of-states process. Checkpoint recovery is checked separately.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/qe-scf-nscf-dos — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

siesta-dft-restart.summary: SIESTA calculates electronic structure with density functional theory.
siesta-dft-restart.workload: Each case starts a cold self-consistent calculation, perturbs the geometry and restarts from the computed density matrix.
siesta-dft-restart.correctness: Eigenvalues, forces, stresses, grid fields and density-matrix entries must reproduce the reference within tolerance. The self-consistent calculation must converge.
siesta-dft-restart.timing: The cold calculation and its restart are timed as complete processes. A separate recovery check uses the unmodified application.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/siesta-dft-restart — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

fluidity-heat-checkpoint.summary: Fluidity simulates heat evolution on a distributed mesh and tracks detectors through a restart.
fluidity-heat-checkpoint.workload: The heat case redistributes a mesh before a discontinuous Galerkin solve. The checkpoint case generates a mesh, runs the simulation and resumes the detectors in a fresh process.
fluidity-heat-checkpoint.correctness: Mesh topology, fields and statistics must agree with the reference. Mesh, halo and detector checkpoints must match, and the unmodified solver must recover the same result.
fluidity-heat-checkpoint.timing: Heat timing includes redistribution and the solve. Checkpoint timing includes mesh generation, the initial run and its restart.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/fluidity-heat-checkpoint — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

icon-atmosphere-checkpoint.summary: ICON simulates atmospheric flow on a global grid.
icon-atmosphere-checkpoint.workload: The task runs the Hadley and JABW atmosphere cases on the upstream grid and writes full-field history and checkpoint outputs.
icon-atmosphere-checkpoint.correctness: The task checks conservation and the outputs of the restarted atmosphere simulation.

sources.correctness: arXiv:2611.20882v1, Appendix D.1, Table 14, p. 28; scripts/task-metadata-v11.json, icon-atmosphere-checkpoint.description.

mpas-atmosphere-restart.summary: MPAS-A computes an atmospheric forecast on a spherical mesh.
mpas-atmosphere-restart.workload: Each case initializes the prescribed grid, runs a Jablonowski–Williamson forecast and writes the model history and restart state.
mpas-atmosphere-restart.correctness: The verifier compares initial, history and restart arrays with the reference, checks air-mass conservation and tests checkpoint continuation.
mpas-atmosphere-restart.timing: Initialization and the forecast are timed. Checkpoint continuation runs outside the timed interval.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/mpas-atmosphere-restart — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

nemo-lock-exchange.summary: NEMO simulates a lock-exchange flow in an ocean model.
nemo-lock-exchange.workload: The distributed ocean run writes full history fields and restart files at the checkpoint and final steps.
nemo-lock-exchange.correctness: NetCDF variables, dimensions and fields must match the reference. The unmodified ocean model must resume from the checkpoint and recover the prescribed final state.
nemo-lock-exchange.timing: The timer covers the initial ocean simulation. Restart runs and output comparisons follow separately.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/nemo-lock-exchange — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

openfoam-cavity-piso.summary: OpenFOAM computes transient velocity and pressure fields for a cavity flow.
openfoam-cavity-piso.workload: The workflow constructs the cavity mesh, checks it and advances the supplied case with the pisoFoam solver.
openfoam-cavity-piso.correctness: Complete velocity and pressure fields must match the reference at the prescribed output times. The verifier also checks probe velocities and flow summaries.
openfoam-cavity-piso.timing: Mesh generation, mesh checking and the solver all contribute to the measured time.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/openfoam-cavity-piso — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

palabos-lattice-boltzmann.summary: Palabos simulates fluid flow with a lattice Boltzmann method.
palabos-lattice-boltzmann.workload: Cavity-derived and periodic shear cases prescribe the lattice dimensions, relaxation parameter, boundary conditions and iteration count.
palabos-lattice-boltzmann.correctness: Diagnostic histories and the final density and velocity at every lattice site must agree with the reference simulation.
palabos-lattice-boltzmann.timing: Timing covers the entire simulation process for each case.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/palabos-lattice-boltzmann — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

su2-transonic-euler.summary: SU2 computes compressible Euler flow over an airfoil.
su2-transonic-euler.workload: The serial solver advances the supplied NACA0012 mesh at the prescribed Mach number and angle of attack for each case.
su2-transonic-euler.correctness: The verifier checks restart, volume, surface and convergence outputs at every required snapshot, including aerodynamic coefficients and flow variables.
su2-transonic-euler.timing: Timing covers the serial SU2_CFD solver process.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/su2-transonic-euler — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

openmc-multigroup-transport.summary: OpenMC simulates multigroup neutron transport in a fuel-pin geometry.
openmc-multigroup-transport.workload: Each case runs a prescribed criticality calculation with the supplied cross sections, records tallies and writes source banks for recovery.
openmc-multigroup-transport.correctness: Statepoint datasets and tallies must agree with the reference, and the source banks must match exactly and support checkpoint recovery.
openmc-multigroup-transport.timing: Timing covers the complete transport process. Restart checks with the unmodified executable run separately.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/openmc-multigroup-transport — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

shengbte-phonon-transport.summary: ShengBTE calculates bulk lattice thermal transport from crystal force constants.
shengbte-phonon-transport.workload: The workflow computes phonons and scattering rates and solves the transport equation at the prescribed temperatures using the relaxation-time approximation and an iterative solver.
shengbte-phonon-transport.correctness: Per-mode results, conductivity tensors and temperature-dependent outputs must match the reference. The iterative solution must converge.
shengbte-phonon-transport.timing: The complete MPI run across the prescribed temperatures is timed.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/shengbte-phonon-transport — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

vpic-harris-reconnection.summary: VPIC simulates magnetic reconnection in a plasma with a particle-in-cell method.
vpic-harris-reconnection.workload: The distributed simulation runs the prescribed Harris reconnection case and writes diagnostics and a midpoint checkpoint.
vpic-harris-reconnection.correctness: Energy histories must agree with the reference. Field, particle and species diagnostics must match byte for byte, including after checkpoint recovery.
vpic-harris-reconnection.timing: Timing covers the continuous simulation. Deck compilation, restart runs and output comparisons are excluded.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/vpic-harris-reconnection — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

presto-pulsar-search.summary: PRESTO searches for pulsars in a time series.
presto-pulsar-search.workload: The workflow transforms a dedispersed signal containing an injected pulsar, searches for accelerated candidates, folds a candidate and renders its diagnostic plot.
presto-pulsar-search.correctness: The spectrum, candidate files, folding products and rendered output are compared with the unmodified workflow, with an allowance for record padding.
presto-pulsar-search.timing: Timing includes the Fourier transform, acceleration search, folding and plot rendering.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/presto-pulsar-search — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

abyss-genome-assembly.summary: ABySS assembles short sequencing reads into contigs using a de Bruijn graph.
abyss-genome-assembly.workload: Generated reads are assembled with the prescribed k-mer length and coverage cutoff, followed by contig statistics.
abyss-genome-assembly.correctness: The verifier checks contig length, N50 and k-mer agreement. The graph, coverage histogram and assembly statistics must match the reference, and repeated assembly must be reproducible.
abyss-genome-assembly.timing: Timing covers the run-only assembly and statistics workflow after compilation.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/abyss-genome-assembly — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

mhm2-metagenome-assembly.summary: MHM2 coassembles paired sequencing reads from a synthetic community.
mhm2-metagenome-assembly.workload: The supplied paired reads pass through contigging and scaffolding rounds, followed by read alignment and abundance estimation.
mhm2-metagenome-assembly.correctness: The verifier checks sequence content, checkpoint contigs, graph connectivity, read alignments and abundance outputs.
mhm2-metagenome-assembly.timing: The entire coassembly driver is timed. Input generation and output checks run separately.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/mhm2-metagenome-assembly — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

mrbayes-phylogenetics.summary: MrBayes infers phylogenetic trees from DNA alignments.
mrbayes-phylogenetics.workload: Independent coupled Markov chains sample trees, save their state midway and then resume to produce posterior summaries.
mrbayes-phylogenetics.correctness: Parameter and tree samples, the consensus tree, posterior summaries and checkpoint recovery are checked.
mrbayes-phylogenetics.timing: Timing includes the initial and resumed inference processes and their posterior analysis.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/mrbayes-phylogenetics — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

wtdbg2-long-read-assembly.summary: wtdbg2 assembles noisy long reads and computes consensus sequences.
wtdbg2-long-read-assembly.workload: The assembler and consensus caller process generated PacBio- and nanopore-style reads.
wtdbg2-long-read-assembly.correctness: The verifier checks the graph and layout, genome recovery, contig statistics and k-mer agreement. Replaying consensus from the layout must reproduce the sequence.
wtdbg2-long-read-assembly.timing: Timing covers the run-only assembly and consensus workflow, with the same process tracing applied to both builds.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/wtdbg2-long-read-assembly — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

hpcg-multigrid-pcg.summary: The HPCG-derived task solves sparse linear systems on a structured grid.
hpcg-multigrid-pcg.workload: The program constructs the prescribed stencil matrix and solves for both supplied right-hand sides.
hpcg-multigrid-pcg.correctness: Both full solution vectors must be finite, satisfy the error and residual bounds and reproduce the same values on a repeated run.
hpcg-multigrid-pcg.timing: Timing includes reading the input, constructing the matrix, solver setup, both solves and writing the solutions.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/hpcg-multigrid-pcg — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

hpl-dense-lu.summary: The HPL-derived task solves a dense linear system using MPI.
hpl-dense-lu.workload: The application loads and distributes the prescribed matrix and right-hand side, solves the system and exports the full vector.
hpl-dense-lu.correctness: The verifier checks the exported solution against the known solution and measures its residual.
hpl-dense-lu.timing: Timing covers MPI startup, data loading and distribution, the solve, full result export and shutdown.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/hpl-dense-lu — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

fegrass-graph-sparsification.summary: The graph sparsification task builds a sparse graph to precondition linear solves.
fegrass-graph-sparsification.workload: A generated graph is sparsified and factored before conjugate-gradient solves for multiple right-hand sides.
fegrass-graph-sparsification.correctness: The selected edges must match the reference. The verifier checks the sparse matrix, the Laplacian factor, convergence and the reported residuals.
fegrass-graph-sparsification.timing: The entire workflow process is timed, from reading the request through writing the result.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/fegrass-graph-sparsification — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

minivite-louvain.summary: miniVite identifies communities in a weighted graph using the first phase of distributed Louvain clustering.
minivite-louvain.workload: Each MPI run reads a generated graph, exchanges community assignments and iterates until convergence.
minivite-louvain.correctness: The current and target partition for every vertex at every iteration must match the reference up to community-label renaming. Repeated runs must reproduce the same output.
minivite-louvain.timing: Timing covers the entire MPI process.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/minivite-louvain — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

nufft-imaging.summary: NUFFT imaging reconstructs an image from nonuniform Fourier measurements.
nufft-imaging.workload: The application bins the observations and solves a regularized inverse imaging problem with conjugate gradients.
nufft-imaging.correctness: The verifier checks the permutation, bin offsets, reconstructed image, residual and iteration history against reference computations.
nufft-imaging.timing: Timing covers the complete reconstruction process.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/nufft-imaging — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

tucker-reconstruction.summary: Tucker reconstruction compresses and reconstructs an image tensor.
tucker-reconstruction.workload: The application processes the supplied tensor at the requested ranks and repeats the prescribed contractions.
tucker-reconstruction.correctness: The final tensor, intermediate reconstruction stages, shapes and reconstruction error must agree with the reference.
tucker-reconstruction.timing: Timing covers one workflow process, including reading the request and writing the complete result.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/tucker-reconstruction — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

quest-circuit-simulation.summary: QuEST simulates quantum circuits using state vectors and density matrices.
quest-circuit-simulation.workload: The application executes every gate on generated circuits and returns the complete state and per-qubit measurement probabilities.
quest-circuit-simulation.correctness: Every amplitude or density-matrix entry and each measurement probability must agree with an independent simulator. The state must be normalized and repeatable.
quest-circuit-simulation.timing: Timing covers the full-state runner process for each generated circuit.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/quest-circuit-simulation — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

qibotn-tensor-network-circuits.summary: QiboTN simulates parameterized quantum circuits and computes observables.
qibotn-tensor-network-circuits.workload: Each input specifies an entangling circuit whose full state and observables are computed on the CPU.
qibotn-tensor-network-circuits.correctness: An independent state-vector simulation supplies the reference for amplitudes, normalization, single-qubit expectations, selected probabilities and the tensor-network observable.
qibotn-tensor-network-circuits.timing: Each circuit runs in a fresh Python process. Timing includes interpreter startup, imports and the complete workflow.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/qibotn-tensor-network-circuits — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

paged-lm-generation.summary: The paged generation task runs a language model with paged key-value caches.
paged-lm-generation.workload: A NumPy implementation loads the supplied SmolLM2 weights, prefills a prompt, decodes tokens, checkpoints the state and resumes generation in a fresh process.
paged-lm-generation.correctness: The verifier compares layer states, caches, sampling probabilities and tokens with an independent implementation and checks the recovery position.
paged-lm-generation.timing: Timing includes model loading, prefill, decoding, checkpointing and resumed generation across both processes.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/paged-lm-generation — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

thundersvm-train-predict.summary: ThunderSVM trains a support vector classifier and predicts labels from the saved model.
thundersvm-train-predict.workload: Cases use Adult-derived data and a generated radial-basis-function problem. Separate prediction processes reload each trained model.
thundersvm-train-predict.correctness: The verifier checks the saved classifier, support vectors and predictions.
thundersvm-train-predict.timing: Timing includes training and both prediction processes on the generated radial-basis-function problem and the transformed Adult workload.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/thundersvm-train-predict — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

datalife-io-monitoring.summary: DataLife monitors file access and reconstructs the dataflow graph and critical path of an I/O workflow.
datalife-io-monitoring.workload: A fixed driver performs the prescribed file operations under the monitor, then the analysis program processes the recorded observations.
datalife-io-monitoring.correctness: File contents, block-access counts and order, graph edges, critical paths and rankings must agree with the independently computed results.
datalife-io-monitoring.timing: Timing includes all monitored I/O stages and the subsequent analysis process.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/datalife-io-monitoring — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.

io500-file-io.summary: The IO500-derived task exercises parallel file I/O and filesystem metadata operations.
io500-file-io.workload: The MPI workload runs the prescribed IOR reads and writes, metadata creation, lookup and deletion, and parallel file search.
io500-file-io.correctness: The verifier checks file data, metadata operations and the required retention and deletion of files.
io500-file-io.timing: Timing covers the entire MPI run, including the same system-call tracing overhead for both builds.

sources.workload, correctness, timing (release i: https://hub.harborframework.com/tasks/accelerate-bench/io500-file-io — Instruction (instruction.md), Correctness and Timing and score.
